patches.name: Force enable Megaphone, Tamper Detection, Krutrim and Kruti
patches.description: Forces the Megaphone, Tamper & Fall Detection, Krutrim Assistant, and Kruti features to always report as available, regardless of the server-driven onboarding feature flags returned by the app's backend.

patches.name: High quality document upload
patches.description: Raises the JPEG re-encode quality used by the camera capture-with-compression flow from 0 to 100, and raises the 6MB per-file size limit enforced on document uploads to 100MB, so scanned documents and high-resolution photos are no longer degraded or rejected before upload.
